description:
What if you didn't have to choose between space, quality, and affordability? 

In this video, Jose, Elijah, and Trinidad take you on a full walk through of the Solution. A thoughtfully designed 4 bedroom, 2 bathroom double wide with over 1,500 square feet of living space that's quickly becoming a favorite for growing families.

We call it " The Solution" because it solves one of the biggest challenges homebuyers face; finding a home with enough space for the whole family with a price point that makes sense!

Come experience "The Solution" in person and see why so many families are falling in love with this floor plan. 

Schedule your private tour today!
☎️ (325)676-9700
📍 3301 Hickory St., Abilene, Tx
